lines.text: A wise son heeds his father’s discipline, and he who guards his mouth protects his life.
Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but desire fulfilled is a tree of knowledge.
A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a faithful envoy brings healing.
He who walks with the wise will become wise, but the companion of fools will be destroyed.
A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the sinner’s wealth is passed to the priests.
